notes: The counts and denominators match the served row. Counts are patients with at least one hypoglycemia episode, not numbers of episodes; arm assignment follows the stated linagliptin/placebo order. Denominators are explicitly presented in the abstract as randomized arm sizes; the results also state that 6979 of 6991 enrollees received at least one dose, without separately specifying treated denominators by arm. Participants with end-stage renal disease were excluded. The held XML contains abstracts and metadata but no full article body. The window is the overall trial median follow-up.
